source.rationale: D2 fires on the domain tool's own `alternatives` — never invented. On the entity axis the mass-noun for the domain ('stock' for inventory) leads the sentence, the asked code comes from the gate's first compatible entity, and the alternative VALUES become both the try-list and the quick-reply buttons. The dym map links the asked code to each alternative so a bare code reply resolves to the right entity next turn.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED for the team-name DISPLAY fix (captain 2026-08-24). An internal team slug was rendered verbatim into customer WhatsApp copy ("escalate to purchasing_certification team?"); live has been emitting "marketing_promotion_sorento team" at real customers for 4 turns in 8 days. Underscores now render as spaces at the interpolation. The ONLY difference in this expectation is 1 '_' becoming ' ' inside the team token of an escalate sentence - checked character by character (same length, same offsets, every flipped byte between "escalate to" and " team"); no other field, key or value moved. The raw slug is unchanged wherever it is routed on or persisted.
